summary: Exactly one surface prints the returned error: root.go sets SilenceErrors so cobra stays quiet and main.go remains the single printer, and any user-facing hint (like the unknown-flag did-you-mean) must ride inside the wrapped error rather than a second stderr write.
reason: With cobra and main.go both printing, every failure appeared twice on stderr — doubly noisy for multi-line rate-limit hints and confusing for agents parsing error output. A regen must keep the single-printer invariant regardless of which layer the generator template puts the print in.
validated_outcome: existing root/suggestion tests pass; failing commands emit exactly one error block on stderr (verified live on unknown-flag and mode-conflict errors).
